headline: Emmbi Industries Limited: General Updates
sum: General Updates - Emmbi Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Board s approval, at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, of the proposal for acquisition of 50% of the equity share capital of Britpac AB, Sweden,…
detail: General Updates - Emmbi Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding the Board s approval, at its meeting held on October 29, 2026, of the proposal for acquisition of 50% of the equity share capital of Britpac AB, Sweden, operating under the trade name  FortaPac , by Zastian Pte. Ltd., Singapore, a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company.
